SIX LIMITS THAT APPLY TO THE ROWS THAT DO PASS.
1  Effects are modest. rho 0.18 for torsion against transcription; AUC 0.72 for cytotoxic
class after confound removal; R2 0.43 for the protein-to-mRNA ratio. Real, controlled,
and not large.
2  TWO OF THIS SECTION'S OWN EARLIER CLAIMS HAVE BEEN WITHDRAWN BY LATER LOOPS, and that
is the strongest evidence here that the gates are doing something. This list used to
say the cancer row predicted NON-drivers at 0.7010 -- loop 29 matched instead of
partialling and found 0.4949, inside the null; the inversion was over-control. It also
used to say nothing here predicts a quantity -- loop 22 then did, at R2 0.4332.
3  The feedback that started this project still does not earn its place. Re-run on a
model that cannot eat ATP, with the reference growth rate fixed, loop minus frozen
went from -0.0074 to -0.0013: 82% of the deficit gone, the sign never flipped.
4  Recall is the binding limit and it has a named, measured dead end. The metabolic model
finds a third of real dependencies; PPI degree separates the ones it misses at 0.68 and
adding it makes the predictor WORSE at matched precision, because hub-ness promotes
true negatives just as fast. Naming the missing layer is not being able to use it.
5  BUT ONCE IT WAS. loop 46 is the single exception to limit 4: re-ranking the model's
own tail by predicted buffering lifted precision 0.7658 -> 0.8228 against a
shuffled 95th of 0.7785. And the mechanism is NOT the one that was
hypothesised: all four REDUNDANCY features point the wrong way, and what separates
the over-called genes is CENTRALITY -- they are peripheral, not backed up. The
model is over-calling the edges of its own network, which is scope, not biology.
6  The 4D chromatin model reproduces P(s), the CTCF orientation signature, sub-diffusive
motion and correct loop turnover, and beats a trained CNN on an unseen chromosome
(+0.1986 is the Langevin run; the closed form transfers 0.2974 -> 0.2852).
Its boundaries are still too soft: insulation +0.3617 against a 0.40 gate
and a 0.9285 replicate ceiling. FOUR principled corrections were tried --
loop-bond stiffness, barrier persistence, loading bias, excluded volume -- and only
the barrier fix helped. Excluded volume overshot to a dilute self-avoiding walk
(P(s) -2.11) because chromatin is a screened melt, which is a density condition.
